kd_pre_tax.label: ASSUMPTION
kd_pre_tax.source: Set equal to the 10-year G-sec yield above (the 12-month average)
kd_pre_tax.note: TCS has no borrowings; lease liabilities are the only debt and their incremental borrowing rate is not transcribed. Debt is about 1.5% of capital, so this barely moves WACC.

terminal_growth.label: ASSUMPTION
terminal_growth.note: Nominal INR; kept at or below the default-free INR rate (G-sec yield minus default spread). A case above that cap is set to the cap, and the output says so.
